newsitem.title: USA: Chase reorganizes units in investment bank.
newsitem.headline: Chase reorganizes units in investment bank.

text.p: Thomas Swayne Monday was named head of global services revenue production for all clients of the Chase Manhattan Corp global investment bank.

According to an internal memo outlining a reorganization within the global investment bank, Swayne will have primary responsibility for coordinating marketing activities between the global investment bank client executives and the global services market staff.

In the memo, James Lee, head of the global investment bank, said Nancy Mistretta was named head of a new unit covering the diversified and consumer products companies in the eastern and southeast U.S.
Both Mistretta and Swayne will report to Lee.
Among other changes, real estate syndicated finance was combined with global structured finance under Peter Gleysteen.

Real estate portfolio management was combined with the global investment bank's credit and lending group under Suzanne Hammett and real estate securitization including the Commercial Mortgage Banking Corp became the responsiblity of the U.S. securities division under John Steinhardt.
The memo said a new joint venture will be formed with the U.S. securities and real estate groups to capitalize on growing opportunties in real estate securitization.
